name: Grav
tagline: A Fast, Simple, and Flexible, file-based Web-platform.
description: Grav is a Fast, Simple, and Flexible, file-based Web-platform.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/grav:2.2.13@sha256:a355dd195ae6245bcae467fdfa10b71ae54f0f93c423eb54e3e4c1f920c6fce7
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
